title: RelationshipSuggestions
description: Bounded agent proposals. Source observations are claims to revalidate; producer identity comes from the host artifact journal. No proposal is an accepted graph edge.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the closed, non-authoritative proposal artifact.

suggestions.description: Bounded candidates for human review; these are not accepted source graph edges.

ref.description: Existing qualified stable source object; the host must revalidate it before acceptance.

sourceTargetDigest.description: SHA-256 digest of the configured source target and projection semantics.

nativeRevision.description: Observed native source revision, independent of the object identity.

nativeLocator.description: Optional native lookup number; never a stable identity. Acceptance verifies the returned stable source ID and revision. GitHub work items require this hint.

sourceTargetDigest.description: SHA-256 digest of the configured source target and projection semantics.

path.description: Literal configured repository document path for the observed source object.

commit.description: Lowercase Git commit object identifier for the observed configured branch.

blobId.description: Lowercase Git blob identifier for the observed regular file.

contentDigest.description: SHA-256 digest of the exact observed file bytes.

repositoryRevision.description: Exact repository bytes claimed by the agent; transport cache tags do not replace these pins.

evidence.description: Claimed source observation to compare with a fresh authorized read.

sourceBindingId.description: Configured backlog source in the same gaggle.

requestId.description: Creation request identity scoped to the actual producing run, stage and attempt.

creation.description: Provisional work-item request; resolves only through a confirmed host-inspected creation receipt.

kind.description: Directed relationship meaning; journal-derived relations cannot be suggested.

from.description: Origin endpoint in the configured gaggle source namespace.

to.description: Target endpoint in the configured gaggle source namespace.

rationale.description: Agent explanation for human review; it confers no permission or authority.
